description: An upscale residential exterior garden scene photographed at dusk, with deep blue twilight sky overhead and warm artificial illumination activating the landscape. The setting features a long, low boundary wall constructed from creamy white limestone or travertine-clad masonry, with a smooth, flat coping surface running the length of the frame. The wall extends from the immediate foreground into the middle distance, creating a strong horizontal perspective line that draws the eye toward the rear of the garden. To the left of the wall, a manicured lawn of lush green grass is bordered by dense low-growing shrubs with rounded forms and glossy foliage. A stone-paved pathway of large-format light grey pavers runs parallel to the wall on the left side, connecting the foreground to a brightly lit modern home visible in the background. The house facade is white render with dark-framed floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors and large windows through which warm interior light spills outward onto the patio terrace. A second contemporary dwelling is partially visible beyond a tall horizontal-board cedar fence that forms the rear boundary, its warm timber tones aging gracefully. Mature trees with bare upper branching silhouette softly against the darkening sky in the far background. Ornamental plantings — shaped box balls, low perennials, and taller accent shrubs — are scattered throughout the garden beds, several of which receive gentle upward-washing warm illumination from ground-level sources, creating soft golden pools of light at their bases without revealing the means of illumination. The overall color palette is cool deep blue from the twilight sky contrasted against warm amber and honey tones radiating across the stone surfaces. The mood is serene and editorial — calm, considered, and luxurious in its restraint. Camera is positioned at a low-to-seated height of approximately two to three feet, level pitch, using a moderate wide-to-normal lens of roughly 28–35mm equivalent. The composition is an off-center thirds arrangement with the boundary wall running diagonally from lower-left foreground to upper-right middle distance, placing the near wall post in the left-center of the frame and the second wall post in the right-center middle distance. The shot is a wide establishing view capturing the full depth of the garden. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
